_source: Bushido Coda (GameMaker, 2013) and its Android build (03-15-13); see docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md and the tuning provenance in docs/BIBLE.md. Each section below says which of its figures come from the original and which are the rebuild's own.

duel._source: obj_gameclock startup_time = 3 * room_speed (counted once the round transition's loading image is gone, at once for the first round), countdown_time = 4 * room_speed (Get Ready for a quarter, then 3, 2, 1 at 25%, 50%, 75%) and drumroll_time = irandom_range(3 * room_speed, 6.5 * room_speed); the timeout (online play only: a local round waits for the first strike, as gameclock_action did) and the settle window are the rebuild's own, for timestamped and networked input.

ai._source: The rebuild's Easy / Normal / Hard ranges standing in for the original's adaptive ART opponent (docs/BIBLE.md).

options._source: The rebuild's old deviations from the original, kept as opt-in options and never the default (UQD-T72; docs/BIBLE.md 4.8). Each is false here and when left out, so this profile plays the original: arenaPerRound draws a fresh arena every round (UQD-T63), letterStrikeKeys adds A / L strike keys (UQD-T69), readyWaitsForStart makes a local startup wait for Space / Start (UQD-T66), inDuelModeCycle adds Tab / Select to cycle the local mode between rounds with its mode line (UQD-T67), localStrikeTimeout gives up a local round after strikeTimeoutSeconds (UQD-T68).
